Illinois (Illiniwek)

Illinois or Illiniwek refers to a historical grouping of related peoples of the Illinois Country, rather than one present-day government.

Identity and homelands

Illinois or Illiniwek refers to a historical grouping of related peoples of the Illinois Country, rather than one present-day government.

Read the sources [1] Illinois State Museum

02

Historical context

Forced removals carried Illinois descendants west; the Peoria Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma continues this history through its constituent peoples.

Read the sources [1] Illinois State Museum

03

Living communities and further study

The Peoria Tribe’s own historical and cultural writing should accompany the Illinois State Museum’s archive, whose population figures reflect an earlier publication.
